enabled.description: Master switch. Default true — the guard is on whenever the extension is loaded.

deciderUrl.description: Base URL of a running strands-decider server (`strands-decider serve <model> --port <port>`). Default 'http://127.0.0.1:8000'.

threshold.description: Minimum calibrated confidence for a decider "safe" verdict to auto-allow a command. Default 0.85. Below it (or on any "destructive" verdict) the command waits for human confirmation.

timeoutMs.description: Decider request timeout in milliseconds. Default 3000. On timeout the command waits for human confirmation (fail closed).

rememberApproval.description: When true (default), a human-approved command is not re-confirmed for the rest of the session (exact string match).
